subject.title: [Bug]: 2026.6.x regression cascade — memory search broken, then sessions lost on every reconnect (multi-agent deployment broken)

question: Should #95042 stay open as the canonical umbrella for the remaining memory/session/gateway stability gaps, or should maintainers split the unresolved pieces into narrower canonical issues?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes, but the report still mixes bug verification, product recovery UX, and proposed config behavior that automation cannot safely resolve as one fix.

options.title: Split focused remaining gaps
options.body: Create or nominate separate canonical issues for the config-crash proof path, any current memory_search failure, and archived-session recovery, then close the umbrella only after those links are durable.

options.title: Keep one umbrella
options.body: Continue using #95042 as the single coordinator until the reporter provides redacted deployment proof and maintainers confirm all slices are covered.

options.title: Close as partially fixed
options.body: Close the umbrella based on #90030, #89017, and v2026.6.11 session-memory fixes, accepting the risk that the crash and recovery requests are not independently tracked.

recommendation.title: Split focused remaining gaps
recommendation.body: Create or nominate separate canonical issues for the config-crash proof path, any current memory_search failure, and archived-session recovery, then close the umbrella only after those links are durable.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main blame signal and broad cross-surface scope make this a maintainer/product routing decision rather than a single component owner fix.
